**fizzle isn't taking pull requests at the moment** — see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/glossings/fizzle/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

Thanks for wanting to contribute. It's a one-person project with a lot of small
opinions baked into how the API feels, so taking a change in tends to mean
rewriting it anyway — I'd rather say that here than leave this sitting open.

An issue is a better way to get the idea across, and bug reports and feature
requests are both welcome there. Fair warning that this is a side project, so
replies can be slow and I won't get to everything — but I do read them.
